WELCOME TO NAKED WARDROBE. I’M HERE TO HELP YOU FIND THE PERFECT FIT OR ANSWER ANY QUESTIONS.
MY ORDER ARRIVED AND ONE ITEM IS DAMAGED, WHAT DO I DO?
I’m sorry one of your items arrived damaged. Please start a request through our RETURN PORTAL and select the reason that describes the damage. You’ll need a brief description, a photo of the item, and a photo of the care tag inside the garment. Our team will review the request and email a prepaid label if it’s approved.
